2ndplace · EVOHACKS 2026
01

Why we built it

Suspicious messages can be hard to understand, especially for people less familiar with technology. We wanted to make the warning signs and the next step clearer.

02

What we made

The local application combines a trained text classifier, transparent rules, and practical guidance. Screenshot text recognition happens in the browser; confirmed text is analysed by the application backend.

The public demo replays a recorded result. It cannot analyse a visitor’s own messages.

03

Next steps

Independent evaluation on more diverse messages, testing with real users, and a verified public deployment.

Project note

TF-IDF and logistic regression achieved macro-F1 of 0.864 on a previously evaluated 880-message test set. This is an experimental dataset result, not independently measured performance on real-world fraud.
